title.ja: 図1-1 横歩取りの基本図
title.en: Figure 1-1: Basic diagram of Side Pawn Capture

explain.ja: 図1-1は横歩取りの基本図です。先手も後手も玉の囲いに手をつけず、いきなり角道を開けて飛車先を交換しに行くのが特徴です。横歩取りは激しい変化になることが多く、初心者には指しこなすのが難しいかもしれません。ここからはこの基本図にならない指し方を見ます。
explain.en: Diagram 1-1 is the basic diagram of Yokofudori. It is characterized by both sides leaving the king's castle untouched and immediately opening the bishop diagonal to exchange the rook pawn. Yokofudori often leads to sharp variations and may be hard for beginners to handle. Here we see ways to avoid reaching this basic diagram.

section.en: Basic diagram of Side Pawn Taking

explain.ja: ▲6六歩と角道を閉じれば横歩取りを回避できます。この形からは矢倉戦法や雁木の形にするのが指しやすいでしょう。
explain.en: Closing the bishop diagonal with ▲6六歩 avoids Yokofudori. From this form it is easy to aim for Yagura or Gangi.

section.ja: 角道を止めて矢倉や雁木に!
section.en: Block the bishop diagonal and go for Yagura or Gangi!

title.ja: 図2-2 ▲7七角で安全に駒組み

explain.ja: 図2-1から相手に△8五歩と突かれても、▲7七角で飛車先の交換を防げます。ここから雁木に組むのが初心者にもわかりやすい指し方でしょう。角道を閉じれば安全に駒組みできます。
explain.en: Even if the opponent pushes △8五歩 from Diagram 2-1, ▲7七角 prevents the rook-pawn exchange. Building Gangi from here is easy to understand for beginners. If you close the bishop diagonal, you can develop safely.

section.ja: 角道を止めて矢倉や雁木に!
section.en: Block the bishop diagonal and go for Yagura or Gangi!

explain.ja: こちらから角を交換してしまうのも、わかりやすい横歩取り拒否の方法です。図2-3からは角換わりの変化になります。ただし、この指し方は先手が手損するので注意が必要です。
explain.en: Exchanging bishops yourself is also an easy way to decline Yokofudori. From Diagram 2-3 it becomes a Bishop Exchange line. However, Black loses a tempo this way, so be careful.

section.ja: 手損してでも角換わり!
section.en: Bishop Exchange even at the cost of tempo!

title.ja: 図2-4 先手と後手が入れ替わるような形に
title.en: Figure 2-4: A shape as if Black and White were swapped

explain.ja: 図2-3から△同銀と進んだ図2-4では、先手の銀は初期配置から動いていないのに対し、後手の銀は1歩前に出ていて、後手の方が1手多く指したような形です。これは先手から角を交換しに行ったのが原因で、このような手を「手損」といいます。一般的な角換わりでは、▲7七角と先手が角に1手使った後、後手も角交換に1手使うので手損はありません。
explain.en: In Diagram 2-4 after △同銀 from Diagram 2-3, Black's silver has not moved from its initial position while White's silver has advanced one step, as if White had played one more move. This is caused by Black going to exchange bishops, and such a loss is called tempo loss (teson). In ordinary Bishop Exchange, Black spends one move on the bishop with ▲7七角 and White then spends one move on the exchange, so there is no tempo loss.

section.ja: 手損してでも角換わり!
section.en: Bishop Exchange even at the cost of tempo!

title.ja: 図2-5 ここで横歩を取るのが普通だが…
title.en: Figure 2-5: Normally the side pawn is captured here, but...

explain.ja: 通常の横歩取りの出だしから横歩取りを拒否する指し方を見ます。図2-5から▲3四飛と指すと横歩取りの形になりますが、ここで別の指し手があります。
explain.en: See ways to decline Yokofudori from the ordinary Yokofudori opening. Playing ▲3四飛 from Diagram 2-5 gives Yokofudori, but another move exists here.

section.ja: 浮き飛車で相掛かり風に

line.text: ▲7六歩、△3四歩、▲2六歩、△8四歩、▲2五歩、△8五歩、▲7八金、△3二金、▲2四歩、△同歩、▲同飛、△8六歩、▲同歩、△同飛

title.ja: 図2-6 飛車を引いて相掛かり風に
title.en: Figure 2-6: Retreat the rook for a Double Wing Attack feel

explain.ja: 図2-5から飛車を引いて▲2六飛とすれば横歩取りを回避できます。この形からは相掛かりのような指し方になります。
explain.en: From Diagram 2-5, retreating the rook with ▲2六飛 avoids Yokofudori. From this form the game becomes like Aigakari.

section.ja: 浮き飛車で相掛かり風に

title.ja: 図2-7 先に飛車先の形を決める
title.en: Figure 2-7: Settle the rook-file formation first

explain.ja: いきなり飛車先を伸ばしていく指し方も、横歩取りの回避に有力です。後手は飛車先を交換されるためには△3三角と指す必要があり、これで横歩取りの形を拒否できます。ただしこの指し方をすると、先手は将来的に▲2五桂と跳ねて攻める手が指しにくくなるので注意が必要です。2六歩で止めておいて▲2五桂から攻める手もよく見られます。
explain.en: Pushing the rook pawn immediately is also a strong way to avoid Yokofudori. White must play △3三角 to guard against the rook-pawn exchange, which declines the Yokofudori form. However, this makes it harder for Black to attack later with a ▲2五桂 jump, so be careful. Stopping at 2六歩 and attacking with ▲2五桂 is also often seen.

section.ja: いきなり飛車先を突く形に
section.en: Straight into pushing the rook pawn

explain.ja: 後手番でも、角道を止めて横歩取りを拒否する指し方は有力です。後手の場合、△8四歩と飛車先の歩を突く前に角道を閉じることになるので、ここから振り飛車に組む手も有力です。居飛車で戦うなら、ここから矢倉か雁木に組むとよいでしょう。
explain.en: As White too, closing the bishop diagonal to decline Yokofudori is strong. For White, the diagonal is closed before pushing the rook pawn △8四歩, so building Ranging Rook from here is also strong. If you fight with Static Rook, aim for Yagura or Gangi from here.

section.en: How to play by blocking the bishop diagonal!

title.ja: 図3-2 横歩取りの順だが…
title.en: Figure 3-2: The usual Side Pawn Capture order, but...

explain.ja: 初手から横歩取りの出だしの指し方が続いていますが、図3-2の局面から横歩取りを拒否する手があります。
explain.en: Moves of the Yokofudori opening have continued since the first move, but there is a way to decline Yokofudori from the position in Diagram 3-2.

section.en: Into the one-move-loss Bishop Exchange variation

line.text: ▲7六歩、△3四歩、▲2六歩、△8四歩、▲2五歩、△8五歩、▲7八金

title.ja: 図3-3 1手損角換わりの変化に
title.en: Figure 3-3: Into a one-move-loss Bishop Exchange variation

explain.ja: 図3-2から角交換すれば横歩取りを拒否できます。後手に加えて1手損するため手損が大きくなりますが、後手から角交換する形は一手損角換わりと呼ばれ、プロでも研究されています。
explain.en: Exchanging bishops from Diagram 3-2 declines Yokofudori. It costs an extra tempo, making the tempo loss bigger, but the form where White exchanges bishops is called Bishop Exchange with a Tempo Loss and is studied even by professionals.

section.en: Into the one-move-loss Bishop Exchange variation
